notes.title: Small patch to the game
notes.notes:
Hi there, Daztrax here, I just want to inform that sadly 2 songs were deleted from the game and its reason:

[olist]
[*] [b]DO U[/b] by [b]CURE97[/b] due to license limitations.
[*] [b]Light[/b] by [b]Kioshi[/b], requested by the same artist to get deleted as well to the streaming platforms.
[/olist]

Its leaderboards won't be deleted and you will be able to watch it in the next links
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1857370/leaderboards/10578669]Leaderboards: [b]DO U - CURE97[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1857370/leaderboards/8779371]Leaderboards: [b]Kioshi - Light[/b][/url]
[/list]

Also, we'll show new stuff that will be in the new update for the game soon, so stay tuned!

Plus, a small reminder that you can [url=https://discord.com/invite/VuU7fueYYa]join to our official Discord server[/url] to get any updates, chat, and talk about the game.

Daztrax out!

notes.title: Update to the leaderboards and 0.19.0 dev updates
notes.notes:
Hi guys, I'm Daztrax, the lead developer of LEZ, I just wanted to let you know that I made an update to the steam leaderboards to the official songs, now you can see all the scores of all official beatmaps outside the game through the leaderboards page of the game on Steam through this link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1857370/leaderboards/]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1857370/leaderboards/[/url], now this will apply only for official beatmaps, not for custom maps (when the beatmap editor comes out).

Now, about the 0.19.0 update, I uploaded an article to the official website of the game, which you can read it on the next link: https://lez.daztraxstudios.com/news/dev/0-19-0-update-dev-progress-1

Finally, don't forget to [url=https://daztraxstudios.com/discord]join to the official Discord server[/url] of Daztrax Studios, there we talk not only about LEZ but also about anything and everything!

notes.title: The reason of why the 0.19.0 update is taking so long, and more information.
notes.notes:
Hi players, it’s me, the lead developer of LEZ. As some of you already noticed, the 0.19.0 update is taking a lot than expected, if you want to read all the information about this, you can see the [url=https://lez.daztraxstudios.com/news/dev-news/this-is-why-the-0-19-0-update-is-taking-more-than-expected]original article in our official website[/url].

Also, some people asked for the Razer Chroma integration for the game, long time ago we added the integration for Logitech, and we also tried to add the same but for Razer peripherals, and we finally managed to add it for the game [url=https://twitter.com/lezofficialgame/status/1753528561644765208]as you can see on the tweet we made days ago[/url].

We currently have a lot to do for this update, so we greatly appreciate your patience, as we want to provide a game that is as stable and most enjoyable as possible (without bugs or errors).

If you want to be informed about the update or related information, you can [url=https://discord.com/invite/VuU7fueYYa]join the official discord server[/url], as well as follow on social media of the game and Daztrax Studios:

notes.title: 0.8.0 Patch notes + some changes for the next patch notes
notes.notes:
This will be the last patch notes for steam, for future patch notes, you can see it in the help site of LEZ

Also, I really apologize for all the problems in the tutorial, it's not easy to make everything by myself, so I hope you get some fun with the tutorial and the added songs, thanks for all the support.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some bugs in general was fixed
[*]New notifications system
[*]Sometimes the game won't open due to a bug of the save file for new players, now it's fixed
[*]Tutorial is now fixed
[*]New data checking system, this is for improve the player experience
[*]New maintenance system + notifications of new schedule maintenance
[*]Auto detect and auto report bugs/errors added
[*]Options shortcut will be only F1 for now (and F2 for notifications)
[*]Save scores when you don't have internet for submit it when your internet is back
[/list]

[h3]For more info, check the [url=https://help.lezofficialgame.com/home/change-log]change log[/url][/h3]
